outcome: A card that would go to a library, graveyard or hand other than its owner's goes to its owner's corresponding zone.
An instant or sorcery card that would enter the battlefield stays in its previous zone.
A conspiracy, phenomenon, plane, scheme or vanguard card that would leave the command zone stays there.
note: Casual-variant cards, but Forge scripts them.

outcome: A replacement effect applies to a zone-change event before the object moves, and the object ends in the zone the replaced event names.
An object that changes zones becomes a new object: counters, damage, auras and effects on it are gone in the new zone.
An effect that changed characteristics or controller of a permanent spell still applies to the permanent it becomes.
A static ability granting an ability to a permanent spell still applies to the permanent it becomes.
A prevention effect for damage from a permanent spell still prevents damage from the permanent it becomes.
An ability of a permanent uses information from the spell it was, such as costs paid or mana spent.
A leaves-zone trigger finds the new object in the public zone it moved to.
A leaves-the-battlefield trigger finds an Aura that went to the graveyard at the same time or as a state-based action.
A cast permission granted to a nonland card persists on the stack object it becomes.
Later parts of an effect that allowed a cast act on the spell the card becomes.
Later parts of an effect that allowed a land play act on the land that enters the battlefield.
Later parts of an effect, or the effects of a spell whose cost moved the object, act on the object moved to a public zone.
After a madness trigger, effects referencing the discarded card find it when it was moved to a public zone instead of cast.
Stickers on an object are retained when it moves between public zones.
An exiled object already in exile becomes a new object that has just been exiled, so exile triggers fire again.
A face-up object in the command zone turned face down becomes a new object.
An object put into the command zone from the command zone becomes a new object that just entered it.
A card brought into the game from outside it stays in the game until the game ends or an effect removes it.
Spells and abilities cannot affect cards outside the game, except those that bring them in.
An effect that acts on a zone is performed on every card in that zone and not on the zone itself.
